description: Main source file for cellular modem sample application using Zephyr RTOS, performing network setup, DNS resolution, UDP echo testing, and modem power management.

methods.name: sample_prng_random
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random byte using a linear congruential generator.

methods.name: init_sample_test_packet
methods.description: Initializes the test packet with pseudo-random data.

methods.name: print_cellular_info
methods.description: Retrieves and prints cellular modem information such as signal strength, IMEI, model ID, manufacturer, IMSI, ICCID, and firmware version.

methods.name: sample_dns_request_result
methods.description: Callback for DNS resolution result, stores address info if in progress.

methods.name: sample_dns_request
methods.description: Performs DNS resolution for the test endpoint hostname.

methods.name: sample_echo_packet
methods.description: Sends and verifies an echo UDP packet to the specified address.

methods.name: sample_transmit_packets
methods.description: Sends multiple UDP packets and reports throughput and packet stats.
